deployment: Local hybrid lab: manager and gateway in Minikube; authenticated indexer/dashboard in retained Docker containers. Browser bound to 127.0.0.1:8443.
pipeline: Deployed proxy HTTP request -> telemetry TCP export -> Wazuh remoted/analysisd -> Filebeat over verified HTTPS -> Wazuh indexer -> authenticated browser Threat Hunting
browser_verified: Real headless Brave: login HTTP 200, connected Wazuh manager, Threat Hunting charts populated; filtered with rule.groups: bulwark-gateway. Screenshot retained locally in shared/wazuh-demo/wazuh-dashboard.png.
limitations: Plain TCP gateway-to-manager hop inside the lab Kubernetes network; Filebeat-to-indexer and browser use HTTPS.
Self-signed demo CA; browser automation trusts it only in its isolated profile.
TCP reconnect retry is bounded and can duplicate events after partial delivery; no exactly-once or durable outage guarantee.
Not all optional Wazuh modules, external agents or external threat feeds have been validated.
Hybrid lab networking and local configuration are not yet fully represented by the production Helm chart.
Full host reboot recovery has not been tested.
